entries.name: ActionEffectSemantics
entries.proof_gate: Probe/compensation/timeout_spec refs resolve to exact original semantics; unknown non-idempotent effect never blindly retried
entries.risk_rule: Retry policy and verification_mode not weakened

entries.name: ActionProposal
entries.proof_gate: Signed/effective operation specs with explicit discriminator; version/integrity-resolvable context; downstream use and reverse-projection proof.
entries.risk_rule: Keep detailed operation kind as a mandatory, typed effective-operation discriminator separate from broad action_kind transport categories (FILESYSTEM, TERMINAL, etc.) and separate from action_class. A category alone never authorizes an effect.

entries.name: ActionRecord
entries.proof_gate: Recover all attempts, reports, observations, compensation, timestamps; latest_attempt_ref alone insufficient
entries.risk_rule: Action Journal legal history complete

entries.name: CapabilityResult
entries.proof_gate: Crosswalk proof pending
entries.risk_rule: FCA full semantic result remains canonical. L7 CapabilityTransportResult must resolve immutable original and preserve all fields, including needs, rationale and specialist_request.

entries.name: Claim
entries.proof_gate: Source version lineage, evidence links, grounding, support-assessment provenance and temporal validity reconstruct FCA-level meaning.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-02 C01 support assessment governs current support; FCA evidence_for/evidence_against and provenance must remain recoverable via accepted RDMS-03 EvidenceLink relations and historical provenance. FactGrounding remains mandatory for FACT.

entries.name: Commitment

correction_or_overlay_refs.source_part: C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision

all_occurrences.source_part: C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision

entries.proof_gate: Crosswalk proof pending
entries.risk_rule: No direct field union; purpose, owner, scope, links, statement, follow-up, timestamp and sequence remain distinct; RDMS-02 C01 reactivation root mandatory.

entries.name: ConfidenceAssessment
entries.proof_gate: Evidence/verification refs resolve and wall-clock timestamps not silently mapped to commit sequence
entries.risk_rule: Confidence independent of mere ranking

entries.name: ContradictionRecord
entries.proof_gate: State history with comparability assessment, observation references, interpretation/proof separation and unresolved-state query.
entries.risk_rule: Use RDMS-03 lifecycle as current owner. FCA UNRESOLVED is an active unresolved epistemic condition, never map to RDMS-03 RESOLVED. For legacy migration preserve historical UNRESOLVED claim and derive unresolved as nonterminal/non-dismissed with no accepted resolution, only when demonstrably equivalent.

entries.name: Decision
entries.proof_gate: Preserve chosen option, rejected option reasons, evidence, alternatives, constraints, scope, version
entries.risk_rule: Choice/rejection rationale lossless

entries.name: DependencyStamp
entries.proof_gate: Enumerate all nine FCA kinds; RDMS-01 projections cannot bypass currentness checks
entries.risk_rule: Single RDMS-06 freshness semantics

entries.name: EvidenceLink
entries.proof_gate: Observation ID multiplicity, link IDs, acceptance history, signed source trace and exact target/relation preservation.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-03 may bind multiple canonical observation_refs to one EvidenceLink with individual provenance; a FCA single observation_id view can be emitted only when cardinality equals one or via explicit composite link reference preserving whole set, not by silently spawning several independent accepted links.

entries.name: Experiment
entries.proof_gate: ExperimentID/RunID mapping, immutable prediction hashes, risk/authorization, run timestamps, observations and status history.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-03 Experiment is the authorized immutable design; ExperimentRun owns execution and outcome. FCA aggregate Experiment is a compatibility view over the design plus zero/multiple runs; design lifecycle does not inherit RUNNING or FAILED.

entries.name: Goal
entries.proof_gate: Preserve hierarchy, status, acceptance criteria, blockers, provenance and priority as typed-or-unresolved
entries.risk_rule: No fabricated priority class

entries.name: GoalStack
entries.proof_gate: Empty/populated stack yields same focus, project/version and ordering
entries.risk_rule: No fabricated optional hierarchy entities

entries.name: Hypothesis

correction_or_overlay_refs.source_part: C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision

all_occurrences.source_part: C01, second review corrections and final freeze decision

entries.proof_gate: Typed reference resolution for each FCA cognitive relation and explicit authorized OVC verification record.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-02 C01 separates support assessment from lifecycle. Strongly supported or CONFIRMED hypotheses are not CAUSALLY_VERIFIED merely by ranking; only correctly evidenced causal-closure path to OVC can justify verified causal status.

entries.name: InformationNeed
entries.proof_gate: Preserve route, blockers and resolution reference, else require review
entries.risk_rule: No fabricated answer provenance

entries.name: Invariant
entries.proof_gate: All enforcement modes, severity, scope and failure semantics survive
entries.risk_rule: Hard/critical guard cannot be softened

entries.name: MemoryProposal
entries.proof_gate: Evidence, counterexamples, applicability, consent/provenance and approval path preserved
entries.risk_rule: No automatic learning or disclosure

entries.name: MemoryRetrievalResult
entries.proof_gate: Crosswalk proof pending
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-07 retrieval coverage/ranking/filtering remains canonical. L7 MemoryRetrievalTransportResult is a bounded view with required canonical reference.

entries.name: Observation
entries.proof_gate: Raw byte hash, explicit source identity, clock trust, event order, capture integrity and interpretation provenance.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-03 stores normalized observation with immutable raw artifact provenance and source/capture/ingest time separation. The original reported content remains retrievable; a trusted envelope or checksum proves integrity/provenance, not truth of source claim.

entries.name: OperationalCausalClaim
entries.proof_gate: Ref dereference yields full source checklist with chronological commits, authority, specific environment and dependency frontier.
entries.risk_rule: RDMS-02 C01 verification_ref resolves complete FCA causal-closure checklist and its temporal order; canonical causal history and derived dependency freshness are distinct. Staleness is not evidence of causal refutation and later validity does not rewrite historical causal closure.

entries.name: QueryDependencyStamp
entries.proof_gate: Validate exact frontier, proof scope, revision, index generation/hash and freshness
entries.risk_rule: No widened absence proof

entries.name: ResumptionCapsule
entries.proof_gate: Crosswalk proof pending
entries.risk_rule: FCA complete recovery-context fields must remain in verified durable RDMS-05 C01 payload with integrity-pinned header, and resume never auto-dispatches next action.

entries.name: SandboxActivityRecord
entries.proof_gate: Recover evidence of isolation, op counts, output/observation refs and result including partial failure
entries.risk_rule: Containment evidence and outcome preserved

entries.name: Slice
entries.proof_gate: Actual-vs-expected change surface, rollback/proof obligations and all slice statuses remain separate
entries.risk_rule: Plan transition and proof obligations preserved

entries.name: TemporalValidity
entries.proof_gate: CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN map case-insensitively but CURRENT requires validity reevaluation
entries.risk_rule: Enum normalization only

entries.name: TriggerCondition
entries.proof_gate: Crosswalk proof pending
entries.risk_rule: FCA full trigger vs RDMS-05 predicate; use distinct effective names and reconstruct full trigger with both detection and fire axes and exact reaction identity.
